takes.text:
integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action, cinematic, photorealistic, one continuous unbroken ten-second shot gliding forward. The camera glides forward at eye level through an iceberg-strewn bay where humpback whales surface between the ice. The camera tracks the moving subject at slow speed. Midway, an iceberg-strewn bay where humpback whales surface between the ice folds flat like the page of a pop-up book, and the next page unfolds into a slot canyon of striped red sandstone, light falling in a single shaft. The camera glides on into a slot canyon of striped red sandstone, light falling in a single shaft without ever stopping, as if this were the most ordinary thing in the world.

overall_soundscape: Whale blows, the slap of flukes and grinding ice, a heavy paper page turning and card creaking upright, and wind moaning through the narrow rock and trickling sand.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action, cinematic, photorealistic, one continuous unbroken ten-second shot gliding forward. The camera glides forward at eye level through a boreal forest of snow-loaded spruce under a pale winter sun. The camera tracks the moving subject at slow speed. Midway, a wall of fog rolls through a boreal forest of snow-loaded spruce under a pale winter sun until everything is white, and as it thins, rows of lavender running toward a lone stone farmhouse has taken its place. The camera glides on into rows of lavender running toward a lone stone farmhouse without ever stopping, as if this were the most ordinary thing in the world.

overall_soundscape: Snow sliding off branches in soft thumps, a raven calling, the world going muffled and slowly coming back, and bees humming over the lavender and cicadas in the heat.
